decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow has no objection to the variation of the condition to allow for two additional concerts in 2007 only provided that the transport arrangements in the legal agreement are compied with.   It is considered to be in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies (ENV-B.1.1 New development), T.1.1 (The location of development), T.1.2 (The movement implications of development), T.1.3 (Development affecting public transport services), T.1.2 (The movement implications of development) and T.4.3 (The traffic implications of new development).
description: Variation of Condition 2 of planning permission 00/1098/FUL dated 2 October 2001 to increase the number of concerts from three to five to be staged in the calendar year 2007 only
